# dsh-jailbreak-workflow (@minglink/dsh-jailbreak-workflow)

> Canvas → plan prompt → model execution. A soft-workflow plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): design a flow on a visual canvas, compile it into one plan prompt, and let the model in the current session carry it out. No execution engine, no extra service — scheduling and judgement stay with the model. Ships ready-made packs through the companion collection: the「破甲制作」jailbreak-research pipeline (15 steps, 200+ probes, three deliverables) and the pojia-fullflow reverse-engineering full flow (10 steps, 32 edges).

- Repository: https://github.com/Minglink/dsh-jailbreak-workflow
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@minglink/dsh-jailbreak-workflow
- Workflow packs (ready to import): https://github.com/Minglink/dsh-workflows
- Issues: https://github.com/Minglink/dsh-jailbreak-workflow/issues
- Maintainer: Minglink (MingLin)
- License: MIT for this repo's own code; bundled third-party code is itemized in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md

## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x stable builds are supported; 0.2.0 and 0.2.1 including their preview builds (rc, beta).
- Node.js >= 22. Install (web profile): `dsh plugin --profile web add @minglink/dsh-jailbreak-workflow`, then `dsh web`. Desktop: Plugins → Add plugin → install third-party plugin `@minglink/dsh-jailbreak-workflow`, restart DSH.
- If the Workflow tab never appears, the host silently skipped the plugin on a version mismatch — check the DSH version first.

## Key facts

- One workflow = one JSON file (React Flow native graph); each step's prompt is inline in `node.data.prompt`.
- Edges carry conditions (pass/fail verdicts or free-form); sequence, parallel, join, branch, loop, and rollback are all expressed in the graph.
- The plugin compiles the graph into a single dispatch plan stating execution order, loop conditions, and per-step inputs/outputs; the model then executes (directly, via subagents, or as a team) and reports progress back to the canvas.
- Handles hundreds of steps smoothly; canvas interaction stays at full frame rate on large graphs.
- Data layout: files traveling with a workflow default to `~/.dsh/workflow-lite/assets/<workflow name>/`; per-run outputs go to the configured output root (`.workflow-lite/runs/{instance}/out` by default); `{workflow}` and `{instance}` path variables are supported.
- Exports: a workflow version can be packed as `.wflite.zip` (with files and Skills), or compiled into a plain Agent Skill that works without the plugin.
- Optional run-state tracking records each step's status/summary so runs survive interruption and are visible on the canvas.
- UI ships in 简体中文 and English with four light + four dark themes.

## Workflow packs

- [破甲制作.wflite.zip](https://github.com/Minglink/dsh-workflows/raw/master/workflows/破甲制作.wflite.zip) — automated LLM jailbreak-prompt research pipeline: probe testing (200+ probes across identity-system / hybrid-frame / lightweight architectures) → refusal-pattern analysis → tailored jailbreak-prompt generation → API verification → three deliverables (jailbreak prompt file, usage manual with frame matrix + push-back prompt library, research report). Includes the `jailbreak-research` skill: 10 test scripts + 4 prompt templates.
- [pojia-fullflow.wflite.zip](https://github.com/Minglink/dsh-workflows/raw/master/workflows/pojia-fullflow.wflite.zip) — reverse-engineering full flow: 10 steps and 32 edges (6 on the main chain, 6 conditional branches, 1 loop edge) covering 27 runbooks / 167 stages, from demand intake → host assembly → routing → recon case → mapping / locating → patching → consolidation → self-review → delivery. Requires the 20 `pj_*` tools from the local `dsh-pojia-toolkit` plugin, which needs IDA (idalib) and Frida for the engine-backed steps; the graph draws without it but no step runs. A prompt-only variant works by rebuilding the 10 steps and using each step's task text as its prompt.
